name: Mississippi

fees.note: Single Trip - Oversize permit $10 (round trip may be purchased).

$0.05 per 1,000 lb (or fraction) over the legal weight x Mississippi miles = $0.10 per excess ton-mile; minimum permit fee $10 (§27-19-81). State counts each started 1,000 lb, so actual fee can be slightly higher. Over-axle loads under 80,000 lb gross are also charged but not modeled.

police.text: 2 police escorts. Two blue-light escorts (front and rear) from 160 ft total length; exceptions at MDOT Permit Division Director's discretion.
2 police escorts. Two blue-light escorts plus height pole from 15'9" tall; route-based exceptions possible.
2 police escorts. Two blue-light escorts for loads of 300,000 lb or more; route-based exceptions possible.

restrictions.text: Daylight Hours: loads 12 ft wide or less sunrise to sunset; wider than 12 ft from 30 min after sunrise to 30 min before sunset. Night moves may be permitted only for loads not over 12 ft wide, 150,000 lb, 99 ft long, 4 ft rear overhang (route-dependent height); at night loads 10 ft wide or more need a front escort on two-lane roads or rear escort on divided highways.

No movement after 12:00 noon on the day before, or on, New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas, unless otherwise permitted. No over-width movement in inclement weather.
Holiday restriction (no movement after noon the day before or on the 6 listed holidays) applies to permitted moves unless the permit says otherwise.
18 ft wide and over: a police ('blue light') escort may be required depending on route and load conditions (General Permit Regulations say 20 ft).

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
travel.note: Wider than 12 ft: 30 minutes after sunrise to 30 minutes before sunset.

notes: Escort rules for over-length (> 99 ft) and 15 ft+ overhang say 'front and/or rear escort'; calculator assumes one escort. MDOT may add escorts (incl. height pole, front and rear) on the permit, and escorts may be required on bridges.
Super Loads need written utility/railroad acknowledgements (height over 16'7", length over 120'), axle diagrams, route survey and a traffic control plan.
Overweight fee is charged on weight above legal (80,000 lb gross or 20,000 single / 34,000 tandem axle) - verify the per-1,000-lb rounding on the ExpressPass quote.
Out-of-state vehicles without Mississippi IRP may also need a $25 72-hour trip permit (not included).
Permits are valid on state-maintained highways and Interstates; local roads need local approval.
